cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'PYEOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Simply remove "type": "module" using a simpler command
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('grep -n "\"type\":" /opt/areloria/package.json /opt/areloria/server/package.json | grep -v "typescript" | grep -v "type-graphql"')
print("Type lines found:")
print(stdout.read().decode())
# Delete these lines
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('sed -i \'/^    "type": "module",$/d\' /opt/areloria/package.json')
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('sed -i \'/^    "type": "module",$/d\' /opt/areloria/server/package.json')
# Verify
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('grep "type.*module" /opt/areloria/package.json /opt/areloria/server/package.json || echo "No type:module found"')
print("\nAfter fix:")
print(stdout.read().decode())
# Also rebuild to be sure
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && pnpm run build 2>&1 | tail -10")
print("\n=== Rebuild ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
